topics.name: Agent skills, tool use, and coding assistants
topics.summary: These studies evaluate tool calling, browser and coding agents, reusable skills, function selection, and runtime scaffolds through controlled tasks and diagnostic benchmarks, showing that orchestration and error attribution matter as much as model choice.

topics.name: Retrieval-augmented generation and agent memory
topics.summary: Retrieval systems combine dense and multi-vector search, graph evidence, memory, query reformulation, and counterfactual audits for enterprise, industrial, legal, and long-context tasks, with provenance and failure recovery as central criteria.

topics.name: LLM safety, alignment, and behavioral evaluation
topics.summary: Safety work studies guardrails, prompt privilege, reasoning reliability, deceptive behavior, oversight, and evaluation cost with probes, stress tests, and structured audits that expose gaps hidden by aggregate accuracy.

topics.name: Vision-language representation and reasoning
topics.summary: Vision-language papers learn shared representations, spatial grounding, visual counterfactuals, and multimodal reasoning for diagrams, faces, aerial scenes, and action quality, using benchmarks and alignment losses to test generalization.

topics.name: Diffusion models for image, video, and audio generation
topics.summary: Generative studies use diffusion bridges, flow models, controllable priors, and latent audio representations for MRI, exposure correction, video, music, and speech, balancing fidelity, temporal coherence, and compute.

topics.name: Image restoration and enhancement
topics.summary: Restoration methods model degradation, exposure, underwater scattering, road defects, and medical noise with guided priors or latent controls; evaluations link perceptual recovery to downstream detection and diagnosis.

topics.name: 3D reconstruction, Gaussian splatting, and neural rendering
topics.summary: 3D work improves Gaussian splatting, implicit fields, occupancy, event-stream reconstruction, and endoscopic mapping using geometric consistency, uncertainty, and mixed-quality views for scenes and clinical guidance.

topics.name: Detection, segmentation, and visual recognition
topics.summary: Visual recognition studies combine radar or RF cues, transformers, language prompts, uncertainty, and foundation features for defects, tiny objects, faces, signs, anatomy, and surveillance, emphasizing robustness in difficult conditions.

topics.name: Robotics and embodied manipulation
topics.summary: Robotics papers learn affordances, disassembly plans, world models, memory, underwater control, and surgical motions from demonstrations or simulation, measuring transfer, smoothness, and recovery in physical tasks.

topics.name: Navigation, autonomous driving, and trajectory planning
topics.summary: Navigation studies generate instructions, model urban or underwater environments, coordinate vehicles, and plan under uncertainty using video priors, topology, behavioral taxonomies, and predictive control.

topics.name: Speech, audio, and music generation
topics.summary: Audio work develops neural codecs, full-band transformers, diffusion and autoregressive music models, speech synthesis, emotion modeling, audio-visual separation, and controllable retrieval for expressive signals.

topics.name: Graph learning and relational modeling
topics.summary: Graph methods address multi-agent collaboration, trajectory-user links, voting or relational structure, and topology-aware representations with spectral, neural, and knowledge-graph tools that improve coordination and interpretability.

topics.name: Efficient inference, compression, and accelerator systems
topics.summary: Efficiency research targets KV caches, visual tokens, speculative decoding, sparse experts, WebGPU, activation memory, and model dispatch; experiments quantify latency, memory, energy, and quality trade-offs at deployment scale.

topics.name: Model training, adaptation, and self-distillation
topics.summary: Training papers study adapters, pruning, self-distillation, reasoning supervision, continual learning, position encoding, and modality alignment across language, vision, and recommendation models, with robustness and transfer as recurring goals.

topics.name: Federated, private, and distributed learning
topics.summary: Federated methods use reputation, attention autoencoders, sparse adaptation, and privacy-preserving aggregation for heterogeneous clients, balancing communication and personalization against anomaly or adversarial risk.

topics.name: Medical imaging and clinical AI
topics.summary: Clinical systems cover endoscopy, report generation, MRI and CT synthesis, pathology, EHR outcomes, radiotherapy, and mental-health support, combining multimodal learning with calibrated uncertainty and downstream clinical evaluation.

topics.name: Time-series forecasting and dynamical systems
topics.summary: Temporal models address radar nowcasting, RF sensing, energy, stock prediction, count processes, and dynamical world models with decomposition, state-space structure, uncertainty, and test-time adaptation.

topics.name: Scientific machine learning and physical simulation
topics.summary: Scientific studies use neural operators, fuzzy differential solvers, spacecraft dynamics, acoustic localization, photovoltaics, and materials models, embedding physical laws or uncertainty into data-driven prediction.

topics.name: Recommenders and preference learning
topics.summary: Recommendation research models modality bias, expert merging, agentic preferences, fraud review, and fairness with user representations, constrained objectives, and decision-support workflows beyond top-k accuracy.

topics.name: NLP, multilingual modeling, and language grounding
topics.summary: Language papers examine multilingual reasoning, translation bias, legal and financial comprehension, mental-health NLP, emotion, song lyrics, and scientific entities through targeted datasets and evaluations of language consistency.

topics.name: Generative models for biology and structured scientific data
topics.summary: Generative methods synthesize brain MRI, clinical images, molecular or phenotype representations, and structured scientific signals, using anatomy, retrieval, or domain constraints to improve plausibility and utility.

topics.name: Security, anomaly detection, and robustness
topics.summary: Security studies cover malicious skills, adversarial transfer, secret sharing, industrial defects, prompt injection, and surveillance anomalies, pairing threat models with robust detectors, explainable reports, or certified defenses.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning and sequential decision-making
topics.summary: Sequential decision papers study rewards, self-distillation, multi-agent coordination, energy dispatch, underwater control, bargaining, and policy adaptation with simulation and real-world constraints on safety and efficiency.

topics.name: Statistical learning theory and uncertainty
topics.summary: Theory work develops results for sparse regression, conformal changepoints, voting, kernel methods, metaplectic networks, and uncertainty propagation, connecting assumptions to finite-sample guarantees and reliable prediction.

topics.name: Human-AI interaction and social systems
topics.summary: Human-centered research studies workplace delegation, health wearables, education, social finance, visual analytics, music practice, and participatory AI through user studies and decision-support evaluations.

topics.name: Information retrieval and search
topics.summary: Search papers analyze agentic commerce, influence maximization, retrieval training, visual document indexing, temporal search, and RAG failures using graph structure, preference models, and evidence interventions.

topics.name: Hardware-aware learning and mechanistic systems
topics.summary: Hardware-oriented work connects circuit-level interpretation, sustainable chips, GPU dispatch, WebGPU or VLSI efficiency, and multi-tenant serving to measurable resource use and controllable model behavior.

topics.name: Data-centric methods and benchmarks
topics.summary: Data-centric studies build or audit datasets for matting, tiny-object recognition, browser agents, fitness, visual decisions, pedagogical agents, and multimodal QA, showing that annotation and verification design shape measured capability.

topics.name: Explainability and model analysis
topics.summary: Interpretability work uses attribution, latent probes, neuro-symbolic checks, epistemic verification, confidence analyses, and attention audits to diagnose reasoning failures and make predictions easier to inspect.

topics.name: Optimization, control, and operations research
topics.summary: Optimization papers address model routing, airport dispatch, digital-twin calibration, agent-skill reuse, planning, and decision procedures with constrained search, bilevel objectives, and operational cost measures.
